subject.title: fix: compaction usage guards and agent-loop turn correctness

question: Should OpenClaw expose `AgentOptions.prepareNextTurnWithContext` as a permanent public plugin SDK hook, with precedence over `prepareNextTurn`, or keep session refresh behind an internal adapter?
rationale: The hook matches current upstream Pi behavior, but adding it to OpenClaw's generated plugin SDK creates a durable external compatibility contract whose ownership and deprecation policy cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Approve upstream-aligned hook
options.body: Keep the additive context-aware hook and explicitly accept its precedence and compatibility semantics as the public contract.

options.title: Keep refresh internal
options.body: Remove the new public API and implement OpenClaw's session refresh through an internal agent-core adapter instead.

options.title: Split API from bug fixes
options.body: Land the bounded correctness fixes separately and defer the plugin SDK addition to a focused API proposal.

recommendation.title: Approve upstream-aligned hook
recommendation.body: Keep the additive context-aware hook and explicitly accept its precedence and compatibility semantics as the public contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent SDK and transcript ownership history plus the protected assignment make this person the strongest available decision owner.
